functions.name: solveForSlowqP
functions.purpose: Continues qP-wave slowness across an anisotropic interface and reports whether the iterative solution is critical.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses a secant iteration with squared-error threshold 1e-11 and a 50-iteration limit; preserve expression order, float input subexpressions, double intermediates, and float output conversion. Calls sqrt; initial radicands are clamped but iterative radicands are not. In the s*s >= 0.49 branch, sqr remains initialized to zero for the initial eigenvalue calculation despite computing sqrsq; preserve this behavior. Division by zero, NaNs, and sqrt behavior can affect convergence and status.
